text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo! Absolutely not! When I say 
I'm not going, I mean I'm not going~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-What happened all of a sudden?! 
Yesterday you were so excited, saying 
"Let's go have lunch together!"...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, what does it matter anyway! I'm just 
saying I won't go to the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But, but! If you stay on an empty stomach, 
you'll collapse during afternoon classes! 
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Muuuuh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it...! I just had a great 
idea!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I just have to cast a "magic spell that 
fills your belly"! Both of you, combine 
your powers with mine to cast a mega 
spell!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm! "O miraculous grains, fill this 
body"—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—"Invisible Wheat☆"... All right! Now I'll 
be totally fine without eating 
anything...!
(*Grumble~~~~*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh, uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Let's not force it and just go eat, 
okay? Please?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because... today is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, the cafeteria is totally 
out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweep-san, seriously, what in the world 
happened to you~?!
choice_data_list:
She said the cafeteria is out of the 
question, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... There must be some reason behind 
it...! Trainer-san, let's go after her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Sweep-san! Found you...! Um, you have a 
reason, right? Please tell us...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because...! Because, because! Kitachan, 
you said it earlier, didn't you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You said today at the cafeteria, they're 
having a "Yakiniku Fair"...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want to go! If I go 
somewhere like that, my hat will smell 
like grease!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not! This is a magical 
hat Grandma gave me, the only one in the 
whole wide world—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
—Listen well, Sweepy. This hat has real 
magic cast upon it. A very special kind of 
magic, just for you.

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Magic?! Wow, wonderful...! Thank you, 
Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This hat is magical girl Sweepy's beloved 
partner! I can't let anything bad happen 
to it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it in the classroom is out of the 
question, too! It's dangerous to leave it 
somewhere without a barrier!
choice_data_list: You really cherish it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... I totally understand how you 
feel! I treasure the souvenirs my dad 
brings me too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... ahaha! You don't have to worry 
about the smell at all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I heard they were short-handed 
yesterday and helped prepare for the 
fair... They're grilling all the meat in 
the back kitchen!
choice_data_list: Then there's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And it looked so delicious, too! The 
kalbi, offal, and skirt steak with special 
sauce... And the grilled carrots smelled 
so goooood...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Well, that doesn't sound half 
bad... Especially since there's no danger 
of weird smells...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm actually getting hungry♪ Hurry up, 
or they're gonna sell out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wait up...!

Sweep Tosho's stubbornness came from how 
deeply she cherished her hat... And with 
that, the two dashed off to the cafeteria.
